reviewed_by: Codex source comparison; not independent teacher approval
verification_scope: Units 6?9 of the supplied NIE Grades 12?13 ICT syllabus effective 2017. Verifies inventory, wording and table mapping against this PDF; does not establish latest examination applicability or teaching/question coverage.
page_numbering: One-based PDF file page numbers. Printed table page number is PDF page minus 11.
normalization: Whitespace normalized. Original spelling, grammar, capitalization and line-break hyphen spacing retained. Nested open-circle markers in one legacy outcome retained as o and separately represented as child_items.
audit_notes: Independently counted top-level outcome bullet glyphs at their physical PDF coordinates with PyMuPDF. Tally matched the separately reviewed pypdf layout extraction for each of all 42 levels, with no missing or extra top-level bullets.
The outcome counts by unit are 46, 41, 43, 43: total 173. All 173 existing IDs match after whitespace normalization. No omitted, duplicate, merged or removed candidates were found in these units.

All 42 competency-level titles were separated from contents; legacy subtopics had captured adjacent contents text. Competency wording was reassembled from the actual left table column, including cross-page continuation for unit7.
Every contents-column item and nested topic was retained in source order as a flat contents list. Repeated Properties/Applications labels remain repeated in 6.8 because they occur under UDP and TCP.
Level periods sum to 50/68/50/74 for units 6/7/8/9, matching PDF page 11.
Official source has incomplete 6.11-01 and 8.4-07 wording. These records are source-verified transcriptions, not silently repaired claims. Their source_anomaly fields retain the issue.
Source typographic concatenations (e.g. Systemconcept, Routingand routers, Packetswitching, thelogical and improperlydesigned) are retained; they do not indicate invented technical terms.
One 9.6 outcome includes two nested instructions; they remain one top-level outcome, with child_items stored.
PDF page 11 overview numbering after unit 11 is inconsistent with later competency numbering. This file uses unambiguous competency identifiers 6?9, unaffected by that error.
Grade-specific classification is not inferred from the combined Grades 12?13 syllabus. Review is a Codex source cross-check, not a claim of subject-teacher/examination-board approval.
